notes.title: Vote for Soundfall for the Labor of Love Award!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Soundfallers! [/b]

We'd love to get your vote for the 2023 Steam Awards! We are eligible for the Labor of Love award! 

It could not be more fitting for us, as Soundfall has been a labor of love from the start. Throughout the last couple years, we have released brand new updates to keep the beats fresh!

We've brought you new rockin' and rollin' music packs, and more recently a brand new Arena Mode! 

When nominating a game for the Steam Awards, think of your favourite indie games, and think of Soundfall for the Labor of Love Award! 

We very much appreciate all of the fans from across Symphonia and the world! This labor of love wouldn't be what it is today without you. :) 

Love,

Team Noodlecake and Drastic Games

notes.title: We're Back!
notes.notes:
Hey friends! 

We just wanted to take a quick second to address and apologize for the radio silence. To be as transparent as we can, there was some issues internally with the development team that basically grinded the support of Soundfall to a halt. There were a lot of legal issues and what not that you can read about in more detail on the Drastic Discord.

The good news is, all of that has been resolved and that means the game is now out of the weird purgatory it was in before. So we are happy to announcement that something new is coming....NEXT WEEK! 

Stay tuned for more details on Monday!

Cheers
- Team Drastic and Team Noodlecake

notes.title: Whitelist Your Account for Streaming
notes.notes:
There have been a lot of questions about creating content for [b]Soundfall[/b] and this post is here to help! 

1. If you plan to stream whitelist your account first. Just fill out the form on the front page of www.soundfallgame.com.

2. Anyone can stream the game without fear of a take down using the provided playlist. If you import your own library though, you might get hit with something depending on the song.

2. Streaming without being whitelisting could result in your account being flagged however your content will no be taken down. The ability to monetize will be taken away however if you whitelist then it will return. 

Happy Streaming!

notes.title: Soundfall Custom Beatmap Tutorial
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=e6XD-RsKjNk;full][/previewyoutube]

In this version of Soundfall, you can import any mp3, ogg, or wav track in your music library to play in-game! Soundfall will automatically try to determine beat positions for the song, but in some cases it doesn't always get things right. For these cases, Soundfall supports manually creating beatmaps for imported songs, so you can get them feeling just right!

Download links for tools used in the video:

Audacity:
[url=https://www.audacityteam.org/]https://www.audacityteam.org/[/url]
Used for editing beat position data

Vamp Plugin Pack:
[url=https://vamp-plugins.org/download.html]https://vamp-plugins.org/download.html[/url]
Used for BeatRoot Tracker algorithm, for calculating some initial beat positions

Thank you for playing Soundfall!

notes.title: Soundfall - Deep Dive
notes.notes:
As we get closer to launch, the biggest piece of feedback we keep getting is players wanting to know a little more about how the mechanics of Soundfall work. We describe it as a "rhythm based looter-shooter" but what exactly does that mean? How does the music impact the game play and what consequences are there to being on or off beat?

Well look no further as we go a bit deeper into what makes Soundfall truly unique in this brand new Deep Dive video. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Soundfall Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's been a minute. Things have been really busy with the team over the past year to say the least. But we are tuning up our gear and getting ready for some big and exciting news in the coming weeks. 

Firstly we are happy to say that Soundfall is in the home stretch. It has been a long road with a lot of bug fixing, game play balance and that final tiny bit of development that always seems to take the longest to get done. We also want to take a second to thank everyone in the closed beta for your help. The game wouldn't be what it is today without you.

On the fun side our marketing push leading up to release will be kicking off soon. This includes all new assets and more importantly, a brand new trailer! I've watched it a million times and it still gets me hyped. 

If you want to stay tuned to all things Soundfall give the team a follow over on socials [url=https://twitter.com/SoundfallGame]@soundfallgame[/url] or stay locked in here as we will be pushing regular updates now for foreseeable future. In the meantime, enjoy this first look at the new banner art for the game.
